message.content:
The bug is at line 18: ApplicationData records are decrypted and dispatched regardless of the connection state. There is no check that `c->state == Established` before processing application data, so an attacker can send application data before completing the client certificate, CertificateVerify, and Finished handshake steps — bypassing the required TLS 1.3 client authentication entirely.

Answer: 18
